---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a bounded document/artifact capability or public-surface improvement
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or user outcome
Describe the concrete need without assuming new scientific authority or unsupported semantics.

## Proposed contract
Define inputs, outputs, failure behavior, compatibility, and the smallest intended scope.

## Current evidence and alternatives
Separate current implementation facts, active contract semantics, and external standards or proposals.

## Affected surfaces
List implementation, `MANIFEST.yaml`, active contracts, current documentation, metadata, or maintenance surfaces that would need synchronization.

## Acceptance criteria
State deterministic or observable review criteria relevant to this proposal.

## Non-goals and semantic risks
State what the proposal must not imply, especially around scientific validity, provenance soundness, or inherited authority.
